title: Creative Ascension
description: Creative Ascension is a progression-focused Minecraft mod centered on exploration, meaningful advancement, and hidden discoveries. Earn your rewards through perseverance as you forge powerful equipment and uncover long-forgotten secrets.
body:
Creative Ascension
Creative Ascension is a progression-focused Minecraft mod that rewards exploration, knowledge, and perseverance. Rather than simply handing players stronger equipment, the mod encourages them to earn permanent abilities by overcoming challenges, exploring the world, and uncovering its hidden secrets.

Expand your journey beyond vanilla by discovering mysterious resources, gathering Creative Essence from powerful bosses, and crafting new materials and equipment that grow alongside your progression.

Current Features
Creative Ascension is currently in Alpha. The core progression systems are playable, while many planned knowledge paths and features are still in active development. The Kyōmei armor and tool set are currently available only through Creative Mode for testing purposes.

Current features include:

Custom materials, including Creative Ore Chunks, Creative Ingots, Creative Essence, and Creative Vessels.

Progression-based abilities and mechanics unlocked through exploration and advancement.

New decorative building blocks and column variants.

Custom relics, armor, tools, and developer artifacts.

Exploration-driven progression that rewards curiosity and discovery.

Hidden secrets waiting to be uncovered.

Philosophy
Creative Ascension is built around meaningful progression rather than rushing toward the strongest gear. Every achievement represents another step forward, rewarding curiosity, perseverance, and exploration instead of simply increasing numbers.

Knowledge itself becomes your greatest tool.

The greatest rewards are earned—not given.

The journey toward Ascension has only just begun.
